Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-c.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check first: are story 3, story 4, and task 15 done?

What have you finished, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: yesterday you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, and nothing is blocking you.

story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock the summary page work that’s waiting on the idempotency keys?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, are story 5 and bug 12 done?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, and I will add it to the parking lot, so Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timeouts and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted a blocker and commitment: the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review and you’ll chase them today, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.

Admin, about task 14, you said “I should finish it tomorrow” three standups ago—has it been completed? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the task that slipped because the sandbox was down, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll sync with Maya after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

We raised blockers around bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, PCI scan exceptions waiting on security review, and work slipping when the sandbox was down; the summary page is still on track and will resume after idempotency keys are in. A side discussion about gateway timeouts was parked for offline. task 19 is flagged as stale and at risk, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including any for absences or non-responses, are coming in Teams—thanks everyone.
